retrievalProfile.description: A centered, high-contrast character portrait featuring a textured green creature in a white-trimmed hat against a deep blue nocturnal winter background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, highly detailed green character with expressive facial wrinkles and fur texture, wearing a white fluffy hat, set against a dark, atmospheric blue snowy landscape with glowing highlights.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant green character skin against deep navy blue background
White fur trim framing the face to create a focal point
Low-angle lighting emphasizing facial contours and texture
Symmetrical character placement with asymmetrical title layout
coreInvariants: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the face
Deep blue and black color palette for the environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered bust-up portrait occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The character's eyes and the bright white fur of the hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright hat down to the expressive eyes, then following the character's chin to the title block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black and dark blue space at the top and bottom edges to frame the central action.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the character's green skin against low-value, desaturated dark backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm yellows or oranges in the background
Limit red to small accent areas

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, irregular sans-serif with organic curves
letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky strokes with rounded corners
Irregular baselines and varying letter heights
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters appear to have a slight 'squish' or organic bulge
G and R have exaggerated, playful curves

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over the character's chest area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly expressive, organic custom lettering paired with clean, functional geometric sans-serif for secondary info.

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the playful, thick, and slightly irregular feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary weight for the metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic portrait of a textured green creature with a grumpy expression wearing a white fur hat, centered against a dark blue snowy night landscape with soft glowing highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, arched, blocky title in the lower center with a green-to-yellow gradient and thick dark outlines. Place clean white sans-serif metadata text at the very top and bottom edges.

verificationChecks: Is the character skin vibrant green?
Is the background a deep, atmospheric blue?
Is the main title text thick and arched?
Is there a clear contrast between the white fur and the dark background?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific trademarked character silhouettes
Do not replicate exact movie studio logos
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between character and background
Ensure the white fur looks soft and textured
Verify the title gradient is smooth
Confirm the metadata text is perfectly centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Character Portrait + Nocturnal Winter Backdrop + Organic Blocky Typography = Cinematic Holiday Villain Aesthetic
